def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full vertical 2-line is a divider; extend the pattern on its
    # occupied side with an 8-line just beyond the pattern.
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    if div_cols:
        c = div_cols[0]
        side = 1 if c < w // 2 else -1
        cells = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w)
                 if grid[r][x] not in (2, 4)]
        if cells:
            edge = max(x for r, x in cells) if side == 1 else min(x for r, x in cells)
            line = edge + 1 if side == 1 else edge - 1
            if 0 <= line < w:
                for r in range(h):
                    out[r][line] = 8
    return out
